title: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive… (CVE-2026-17344)
description: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. A service that can be reached without authentication could be made to send requests to unintended destinations.
